newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares rise despite political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares rise despite political uncertainty.

text.p: Turkish stocks were higher in mid-morning trade on Thursday despite uncertainty after the resignation of the Islamist-led government late on Wednesday.
Some brokers said share prices may fall later in the day on profit-taking sales and worries about the formation of a new government.
The IMKB National-100 stood at 1,596 at 0805 GMT, up 1.98 percent from Wednesday when it firmed 0.9 percent.

Investors await news from Ankara where President Suleyman Demirel began talks with opposition leaders in a bid to find a replacement for Necmettin Erbakan, pushed into resigning as prime minister by an army-led anti-Islamist campaign since February.

Alp Tekince, general manager of Bumerang securities said Thursday's early rise was a reaction to the recent sharp falls, caused by mounting political turmoil. The index fell two percent on Monday and Tuesdday, on top of last week's 5.2 percent loss.

Brokers said selective demand in state shares fuelled prices despite uncertainty, aggrevated by Erbakan's resignation as part of a power-sharing plan to hand over premiership to his coalition ally deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller, leader of the conservative True Path Party.
Some brokers say expectations that President Demirel will give a mandate to main opposition leader Mesut Yilmaz to form the government pushed up the stocks.
"There is a buying trend but investors are still cautious. They now discount the expectation that Demirel will not ask Ciller to form the government," Ismet Palanli from Ar Securities.
Gokhan Kolay of Polen Securities who blamed the selective activity in index shares for the early uptrend said the trend may reverse later in the day.
"Six month financial results will be announced soon. But there are still political uncertainties. My recommendation to investors is that they should not buy stocks for a while more," he said.
Technical analysts say the index may face resistance at 1,600 level and support at 1,550.
